key_concepts: Animals are grouped into vertebrates and invertebrates
Invertebrates lack cell walls and reproduce by two reproductive cells
Invertebrate body shapes include bilateral, radial, and asymmetry
Arthropods have exoskeletons, antennae, and simple or compound eyes
Arachnids are arthropods with eight legs
Crustaceans are arthropods with ten legs and a cephalothorax
Insects are arthropods with six legs, compound eyes, antennae, and wings
Mollusks are soft-bodied animals with bilateral symmetry
Poriferans or sponges are simple aquatic invertebrates with pores
